# Bankové nástroje pre účtovníkov: jedna Pro licencia pre tri nástroje

> Bundle page for four free, client-side ARLing tools that Slovak accountants use for bank files: SEPA pain.001 Doctor, SEPA pain.001 Generátor, camt.053 do Excelu, and Párovač platieb. One Pro licence works in the last three; SEPA pain.001 Doctor has no Pro tier and needs no licence.

Each of the four tools works on its own, for free, but not all without limits: SEPA pain.001 Doctor checks files and SEPA pain.001 Generator builds and downloads them with no limit on usage, files or downloads; camt.053 to Excel and Párovač platieb convert and match the whole file for free, but without a licence the downloaded file holds only the first 20 rows as a sample, and the MT940 and DATEV exports of camt.053 to Excel show only a preview of the first 8 lines. This page sells one Pro licence for SEPA pain.001 Generator, camt.053 to Excel and Párovač platieb: no separate purchase per tool. SEPA pain.001 Doctor does not read the licence; its automatic fix of a file (29 EUR) is a separate purchase on the Doctor page.

## The four tools

- **SEPA pain.001 Doctor** (kontrola pain.001): https://arling.sk/sepa-pain001-doctor/. Checks a finished pain.001 XML batch payment file against the bank-specific rules of Tatra banka, SLSP, VÚB, and ČSOB before import.
- **SEPA pain.001 Generátor** (Excel/CSV → pain.001): https://arling.sk/sepa-pain001-generator/. Builds a pain.001 XML batch payment file from payments pasted or uploaded from Excel or CSV.
- **camt.053 do Excelu** (výpis → Excel): https://arling.sk/camt053-to-excel/. Converts a camt.053 XML bank statement into a CSV/Excel table with a balance check.
- **Párovač platieb** (párovanie platieb): https://arling.sk/parovac-platieb/. Matches a camt.053 bank statement against a list of issued invoices: paid, unpaid, overpaid.

## What Pro adds (Generator, camt.053 to Excel, Párovač platieb)

Saved payer profiles, processing several files or accounts at once, column-mapping templates for Pohoda, Omega (KROS), and Money S3 exports, a local history of past processing runs, and priority email support. Pro also unlocks the full downloaded file in camt.053 to Excel and Párovač platieb (without a licence: the first 20 rows) and the MT940 and DATEV exports. Checking and building pain.001 files stays free with no limit.

## Pricing

9 EUR per month, or 79 EUR per year (saves 29 EUR over paying monthly), VAT included. Checkout runs through Stripe; ARLing s. r. o. sells under Stripe Managed Payments, so Stripe is the merchant of record and emails the invoice automatically. Cancel anytime; a 14-day money-back guarantee applies (andrej@arling.sk).

## How the licence works

One signed licence key (Ed25519, verified client-side with WebCrypto, no server call on ordinary use) is issued after payment and stored in the browser via localStorage. The three tools with Pro and this bundle page share the same arling.sk origin, so a key saved on any one of them is already visible to the rest; it can also be pasted manually on a different browser or computer. No account or login required.

## Privacy

No account, no login, no server-side processing of your bank data anywhere in the four tools. The only analytics are anonymous usage counts sent to a self-hosted Umami instance.
